findings.finding: The human answer 'yes' confirms the right shin dot on ש in רֹאשׁ. The prior closure_review.json gave status changes_required for this one mark only and said it 'can be approved with no change to the text' once the dot was confirmed. Every other heading mark was already confirmed there: the holam on ר, the shin dot and dagesh in הַשָּׁנָה, the right dots on שֵׁנִי and שֶׁל, the patach, hataf patach and hiriq in מַעֲרִיב, and the tsere in לֵיל. The review also found no meteg on מ and treated the mark over the final ה as a blemish. working/s8.json block 0 is now 'מַעֲרִיב לֵיל שֵׁנִי שֶׁל רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה'. It matches closure_review.exact_heading and user_adjudications_897_899.heading_change.after exactly.

The only field that changed is /blocks/0/text, from 'מעריב ליל שני של ראש השנה' to the pointed heading. Blocks 1–5 are the same in both files, and so are scan_page, printed_page, reader, method, uncertainties, continuation and image_sha256. The citations were already corrected in previous_working_s8 and have not changed: block 2 is 'דברים י״א י״ג' and block 4 is 'במדבר ט״ו ל״ז'. Both match closure_review.exact_citations.

All three prayer fields in working/s8.json match the approved snapshot. I checked all 13 U+05BD metegs from adjudications 878–893 in the current text: וְנָֽתְנ֛וּ, וְאָֽמַרְתָּ֣, לְדֹֽרֹתָ֑ם, לַֽאֲבֹֽתֵיכֶ֖ם (2), לְטֽוֹטָפֹ֖ת, both וְנָֽתַתִּ, וְאָֽסַפְתָּ֣, וְתִירֹֽשְׁךָ֖, בְּשָֽׂדְךָ֖, וְאָֽכַלְתָּ֖ and וַֽעֲבַדְתֶּם֙. The confirmed-unchanged words are also unchanged: אֹת֗וֹ, לֵּאמֹֽר, וּקְשַׁרְתֶּ֨ם and מָטָ֔ר. The absence decisions still hold: וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם has no meteg, וְלֹא־יִהְיֶ֣ה has no meteg, and אֶתְכֶ֖ם has no added mark. The approved snapshot still has the old citation text ('דברים יא יג:' and 'במדבר טו לז:'). That is expected, because the prayer approval was for blocks 1, 3 and 5 only and excluded the citations.

user_adjudications_878_896.json keeps a full smudge_reconstruction record for וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם. It cites urn:x-opensiddur:text:bible:numbers/15/39@tanakh-miqra_al_pi_hamasorah-he, file tanakh-miqra_al_pi_hamasorah-he/numbers.xml, sha256 f1dacd75…3d10, line 135. It quotes the user's authorization in full and states that this is a sourced reconstruction, not a reading of clear print. s8_prayer_source_approval.json carries the same record and requires encoding review to preserve it. The 897–899 adjudication does not touch or weaken it.

working/s10.json block 3 word 19 is מִכַּף and block 4 word 15 is סוּף. I counted the indices by splitting on spaces, and they match the adjudication records. Neither final ף has a dagesh, which matches the human 'no' answers. Both words are unchanged as stated.

None of the reviewed files claim acceptance of the whole batch, export or encoding. user_adjudications_897_899.scope says: 'No encoding, full batch or export acceptance.' The exclusions in s8_prayer_source_approval stay in force, apart from the heading and citations, which this closure now covers.

The method and uncertainties strings in working/s8.json still describe an incomplete draft. s8_prayer_source_approval.superseded_draft_metadata already marks them as historical. Any scan8 approval record written from this closure should say the same for the heading and citations, so the old uncertainty about citation punctuation is not read as still open.

scope_limitations: I only had a file-read tool and no shell. So I did not recompute any SHA-256 values: not working_s8 (5715392f…), not working_s10 (0be68eac…), not the approved snapshot (b6110898…), and not the per-field hashes in s8_prayer_source_approval. I compared the text fields by reading them side by side, not by hash or byte diff. A mechanical check is still needed: confirm that /blocks/1, /blocks/3 and /blocks/5 in working/s8.json hash to e1c90e42…, de752041… and 915efa3d…, and that the file hashes match the values recorded in user_adjudications_897_899. I did not look at the source images or the snippets 897–899. The heading and both scan10 decisions rest on the human answers plus the earlier closure_review. The printed page label '3' comes from the earlier inventory, which I did not re-check here; closure_review itself excluded page numbers. The gershayim are encoded as U+05F4, as before, and cannot be told apart from ׳׳ in print. Not covered: JLPTEI encoding, alignment and order, normalization, the rest of scan10 including its unpointed heading and all other words, any other scan, exports, and batch acceptance.
